H2_calibration.quote: Applying it to U.S. persons "anywhere" invites challenges based on high-seas freedoms and the presumption against extraterritoriality. It is also hard to enforce against conduct far from U.S. jurisdiction.
H2_calibration.note: also item 24: Money penalties alone are hard to collect from offshore or foreign-linked operators, and may be treated as a cost of doing business.

H4_grandfather_step.quote: Applicants with pending applications get nothing, which invites a scramble for licenses before enactment as well as equity and takings arguments.
